name: Rectangular Case
note: The only shape the packing-engine's layer patterns currently handle (column + guillotine-split + pinwheel + interlock).

name: Cylinder / Round Bottle
note: CapePack supports cylinders on pallets with dedicated circle-packing patterns (Column, Interlock, Trilock, Spiral, Diagonal, Expanded Spiral); this engine now implements true hexagonal (staggered-row) circle packing for pallet loads — see packing-engine/src/patterns/hexagonal.js. Compression Strength still doesn't apply to cylinders (CapePack's own limitation, reproduced here).

name: Trapezoid / Tote
note: Not yet implemented — modeled as a rectangular bounding box.

name: Soda Can
